blocks.text: By using the Zscaler AI Scanning Platform Service, you grant Zscaler the right to process, use, reproduce, store, modify and display information from logs.
For AI Scanning Platform, logs capture information such as testing prompts, responsive outputs, and AI model/application configuration data.
Metadata logs related to the operation of the AI Scanning Platform Service, such as timestamps, API request IDs, and API status codes are retained for a rolling period of 28 days.

During the term of your subscription, you may delete specific data sets (i.e., CSV files you uploaded to the platform) directly from the Admin Portal. For data that cannot be removed via the Admin Portal, you may submit a request for manual deletion by our team. When your subscription term ends or expires, the logs are deleted by Zscaler according to applicable retention cycles.
During the deployment process, you can choose to have the logs stored in either the United States or the European Union.
